name: Geisha Training
body:
Though you ended your training early, you have spent many hours practicing etiquette and performance skills.

Prerequisite: Female.

Benefit: You gain a +1 trait bonus to Diplomacy and Perform (any one) and one of these (your choice) is always a class skill for you.
